newsitem.title: UK: Fayrewood says to buy Banque Magnetique SA.
newsitem.headline: Fayrewood says to buy Banque Magnetique SA.

text.p: Britain's Fayrewood Plc said on Tuesday that it had conditionally agreed to acquire the France's Banque Magnetique SA, a distributor of computer peripheral products for an initial cash consideration FF23 million.
Fayrewood would also offer 457,446 shares in its company as part of the consideration.
A deferred consideration of up to a further FF12 million in cash may be payable over a period of four years after completion of the acquisition.
Fayrewood suspended trade in its shares on the AIM ahead of the announcement.
Banque Magnetique, formed in 1987, reported a turnover of 216 million francs in the year to September 1996 with a pretax, pre-exceptionals profit of 5.7 million during the same period.
Fayrewood shares closed at 67-1/2 pence on March 21.
